description: Returns one company's current snapshot: price with its market session (open or closed, last close, next open), performance, 52-week range, trend, fundamentals from its SEC XBRL filings, balance sheet (cash, debt as the filed balance sheet presents it, the financings filed since, runway, share count and dilution), risk (beta and volatility), FINRA short interest and short volume, and its SEC profile with its own description. Every figure carries the date it holds for. Use it when the user asks about one company's price, market cap, valuation, fundamentals or risk. A company not listed yet that has filed a public prospectus (pre-IPO, e.g. 'anthropic') returns what its prospectus and the funds file instead: no price, the last round's price per common share, the implied value on both share counts, rounds, capital, quarters (and an estimate of the next one, said to be one), its commitments to each supplier, Amazon's and Google's stakes rebuilt as floors, customers, facilities, fund marks and profile.

symbol.description: Ticker or company name, e.g. NVDA, AMD, ASML, 'nvidia', 'taiwan semiconductor'. Case-insensitive.

name: get_company
title: Company snapshot
